**Repaired finding submitted — WARRANTY (missing, fallback target).**

What changed from the prior submission:

- **Status corrected to `missing`** (rule expects a Vendor performance warranty; none exists), so the proposal's operation is properly indexed for the coverage gate — the earlier `needs_review` mapping to "operation 1" was rejected as invalid.
- **All four fallback elements now carried in operative text** by a single insert of new Section 13.5.1 after p0739, inside Article 13 so the "EXCEPT AS OTHERWISE SET FORTH IN THIS ARTICLE 13" carve-out in 13.6.2 preserves it:
  - SFJ Services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner and conforming in all material respects for **ninety (90) days** following performance (satisfies the ≥30-day services element and the deterministic ≥90-day period check);
  - any SFJ-provided **software conforming to its documentation for ninety (90) days** — drafted conditionally, resolving the software limb in operative language rather than in commentary, at no cost to PB since no SFJ software is identified;
  - remedy sentence with **re-performance, repair or replacement** and **refund** of amounts paid.
- **Validated:** `propose_redline` returned ok:true with no minimality or anchor errors; no existing text is altered or deleted.
